about.title: About Asimti
about.lead: The unified digital platform of the Mayoralty of Baghdad
about.p1: Asimti is the unified digital platform of the Mayoralty of Baghdad. It brings the services of the Mayoralty’s sectors and departments together in one place, and lets citizens, residents and businesses deal with the Mayoralty online, simply and clearly, from anywhere and at any time.
about.p2: Asimti is part of the Mayoralty of Baghdad’s move towards digital transformation: fewer in-person visits, unified procedures, and a relationship between the Mayoralty and the citizen built on trust and transparency.
about.vision.title: Our vision
about.vision.text: A capital served digitally, where every citizen can access the Mayoralty’s services easily and transparently.
about.mission.title: Our mission
about.mission.text: To deliver the Mayoralty of Baghdad’s services through a unified, secure digital platform that saves time and effort and makes the citizen’s voice part of developing their city.
about.goals.title: Our goals
about.goals.1: Unify access to the services of the Mayoralty’s sectors with a single account.
about.goals.2: Reduce the need for in-person visits and shorten transaction times.
about.goals.3: Make the procedures and requirements of every service clear.
about.goals.4: Enable citizens to follow their own transactions and bills.
about.goals.5: Open a direct channel for citizens’ opinions and suggestions to improve their areas.
about.values.title: Our values
about.values.1.d: We design every service around the beneficiary’s need.
about.values.2.d: Clear procedures and a known status for every transaction.
about.values.3.d: Protecting beneficiaries’ data and verifying their identity.
about.values.4.d: We listen to citizens’ opinions and improve based on them.
about.values.5.d: We keep improving the platform and its services.
about.who.title: Who is Asimti for?
about.who.1.d: A unified personal profile using the national card or residency.
about.who.2.d: A company account managed by an authorised representative.
about.who.3.d: Accounts for official entities and non-profit organisations.
about.what.title: What does Asimti offer?
about.what.1: One digital identity to access the Mayoralty’s services.
about.what.2: A unified guide to sector services: building permits, occupancy permits, water and wastewater, billing and collection, complaints, properties and visit permits.
about.what.3: Tracking the status of requests and viewing bills.
about.what.4: A channel for submitting suggestions and feedback.

about.slogan: Asimti… because serving you is a trust
